description: Password Policy Compliance Check — Audit a password policy against NIST SP 800-63B-4 (2025) and PCI DSS v4.0.1 section 8.3, offline. policy= takes a JSON object, key=value or key: value lines, Windows net accounts output, login.defs or pwquality.conf / pam_faillock text (min_length, max_length, require_uppercase/digit/symbol, expiry_days, history, lockout_threshold, lockout_minutes, breach_check, rate_limit, hints, security_questions, allow_paste, hash, iterations...). Optional standard=all|nist|pci and mfa=true|false. Returns per-standard verdict (COMPLIANT / GAPS / NON-COMPLIANT), score and grade, findings with control references and fixes, the parsed settings, unrecognized keys and a recommended policy. Flags short minimums, composition rules and forced rotation (NIST), missing breached-password checks, no lockout/rate limit, lockout over 10 attempts or under 30 minutes (PCI), history under 4, hints and security questions, truncation, and weak hashing (plain, reversible, fast SHA/MD5, low PBKDF2 iterations or bcrypt cost). Price: $0.004 USDC (Base, via x402).

policy.description: min_length=8; require_uppercase=true; require_digit=true; require_symbol=true; expiry_days=90; history=5; lockout_threshold=5; lockout_minutes=15; hash=sha256
